question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

The food container / is not enough big to meet / the demands of the affected people.

options.text: is not enough big to meet
the demands of the affected people.

solution:
The correct answer is **"is not enough big to meet."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error lies in the part "enough big"</stron
